manifesto.title:
We photograph
the quiet hours
between the vows.
paragraphs: YELI is a small studio of four photographers documenting weddings, private celebrations, and editorial events across three continents.
Our work is unhurried — closer to a film still than a snapshot. We arrive early, stay late, and trust the day to give us its best moments.

chapterOne.title: Light, held.
chapterOne.copy: The hour before the door opens. The breath that no one else sees. We photograph the quiet, and let the noise pass through.
chapterOne.caption: Lawn ceremony — Hudson Valley

chapterTwo.title: Two, and a vow.
chapterTwo.copy: Five weddings a season. We arrive a day early, and we never miss the quiet hours.
chapterTwo.caption: Petals — Florence

pullQuote.quote: Photographs are how we stay in the rooms we leave.
